title: Montreal Boat
specs: Best sound system on party yacht
Cruise historic Old Port, Downtown Montreal skyline, Boucherville Boat Islands, St. Lawrence River
Children are welcome and counted as guests
Pets generally not allowed; ask for exceptions
Bring any necessary medication for allergies or medical needs
Up to 15 guests on Regal 42' yacht
includes: Inside and outside speakers, audio system
Bathing platform, sun pads, fridge, freezer, bathroom
Life jackets, emergency kits, first aid supplies
blurb: Guests board yachts at Montreal Marina and design their own experience cruising the St. Lawrence River, with options to swim, anchor, and enjoy onboard amenities. The fleet includes party yachts with sound systems, kitchen, bathroom, and water toys. Catering by BRERA is available but must be ordered separately through concierge service.
extraNote: 25% refundable deposit required to confirm booking · Balance payable on the day via POS machines · Cancellations made at least 7 days before start date eligible for refund minus $189.99 cancellation fee · Cancellations within 7 days are non-refundable unless due to severe weather · If bad weather forecasted, captain decides on day; reschedule or full refund offered · Security and damage deposit of $1,500 required before experience, refunded same day if no damage · Montreal Marina, look for Montreal Boat banners
